title: New license request: W2FPL-1.0 [SPDX-Online-Tools]
body:
**1.** License name: DO WHAT THE FUCK YOU WANT TO WHEN YOU WANT TO PUBLIC LICENSE
**2.** Short identifier: W2FPL-1.0
**3.** License author or steward: Caleb Gottfried <snvrk@snvrkotics.com> (steward), with the W2FPL coauthors
**4.** Comments: Definitive factors:
A. No match: it derives from the WTFPL (SPDX: WTFPL), renamed as the WTFPL's own
   terms require, and adds substantive text that matches no listed license:
   clause 1 (an explicit free, worldwide, permanent, irrevocable grant) and
   clause 4 (a warranty and liability disclaimer). WTFNMFPL has a liability
   clause but no irrevocable grant; CC0-1.0 is a waiver with a fallback license.
C. Not executable-only: it applies to any work, including source code.
D. Stable text: version 1 is final and published at a permanent URL in HTML and
   plain text.
E. Versioning: as steward, I commit to never modifying version 1, and to
   publishing any change as a new, separately numbered version at its own URL.

Other factors:
1. It complies with the Free Software Definition, the Open Source Definition,
   the Open Definition and the Free Cultural Works definition: it grants every
   freedom with no conditions at all (no attribution, notice, share-alike or
   field-of-use restrictions). Clauses 2 and 3 are non-binding; clause 3
   expressly cancels clause 2.
2. Generally usable by anyone, for any kind of work; nothing in it is specific
   to a project or company.
3. Use: it is the data license of two public datasets, SNVRKOTICS Data
   (data.snvrkotics.com, an open music metadata graph with per-entity JSON and
   a full NDJSON dump) and dripgraph (dripgraph.com, a linked-data archive),
   declared in machine-readable form (schema.org license, HTTP Link
   rel="license"), and of its own repository.
   Both datasets moved to the W2FPL from the WTFPL v2: every entity page, its
   per-entity JSON (data.snvrkotics.com/entity/<id>.json,
   dripgraph.com/ld/<page>.json) and both full dumps
   (data.snvrkotics.com/dump.ndjson, dripgraph.com/dump.ndjson) are distributed
   under it, with its badge and rel="license" on every page. Every future
   release of both datasets will be under it.
5. I'm the steward and I'm submitting it.

It's developed in public at https://github.com/snvrk/w2fpl, and the
license-list-XML and test-text files are already drafted at
https://github.com/snvrk/w2fpl/tree/main/spdx
**5.** License request Url: https://tools.spdx.org/app/license_requests/538
**6.** URL(s): https://snvrkotics.com/licenses/w2fpl, https://github.com/snvrk/w2fpl/blob/main/LICENSE
**7.** OSI status: Not Submitted
**8.** Example projects: https://data.snvrkotics.com/license, https://dripgraph.com/license, https://github.com/snvrk/w2fpl
